name: Sikafloor®-359 AU
tagline: Polyurethane UV Stable Pigmented and Clear Resin Coating
summary: Sikafloor®-359 AU is a solvent based, hard wearing durable 2-part finish coat for Sikafloor Systems. Available as a pigmented finish, clear satin finish or clear gloss finish.
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-359 AU is a solvent based, hard wearing durable 2-part finish coat for Sikafloor Systems. Available as a pigmented finish, clear satin finish or clear gloss finish.
attributes: Excellent in mechanical and chemical resistance
Use as a finish coats for Sikafloor Park Deck Systems
UV stable over Sikafloor epoxy ES, EB & ET systems

packaging: Part A | 15 litres Part B | 5 litres A+B Kit | 20 litres

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.

items.label: Density
items.text:
Clear | Pigmented
Part A | ~ 0.95 kg/l | ~ 1.22 kg/l
Part B | ~ 0.98 kg/l | ~ 0.98 kg/l
Mix resin | ~ 0.96 kg/l | ~ 1.14 kg/l

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Clear & Pigmented - Part A:Part B = 3:1 (by volume)

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Foot traffic: Approx. 24 hrs. at ±23oC
Heavy traffic: Approx. 48 hrs. at ±23oC

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Prior to mixing, stir part A mechanically. When all of part B has been added to part A, mix continuously for 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point. As a seal coat, the product can be applied by squeegee and then back-rolled (crosswise) with a short-piled roller.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
